## `client.files`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.files.FilesManager`.

Files and images stored in content items.

### `client.files.upload`

Create a `File` or `Image` from a file, in one request.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.files.FilesManager.upload`.

Calls `POST /media` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/content-types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.files.upload("/media", "notes.txt", title="Notes")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client upload /media photo.png --title Photo -f @id,@type,title
```

```json
[
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/media/photo.png",
    "@type": "Image",
    "title": "Photo"
  }
]
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/media HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "@type": "File",
  "title": "Notes",
  "file": {
    "data": "TWVldGluZyBub3Rlcy4K",
    "encoding": "base64",
    "filename": "notes.txt",
    "content-type": "text/plain"
  }
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/media -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"@type":"File","title":"Notes","file":{"data":"TWVldGluZyBub3Rlcy4K","encoding":"base64","filename":"notes.txt","content-type":"text/plain"}}'
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/media/notes.txt",
  "@type": "File",
  "title": "Notes"
}
```

This shows only `@id`, `@type`, `title`.

### `client.files.replace`

Replace the file stored in a field of an item.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.files.FilesManager.replace`.

Calls `PATCH /media/readme.txt` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/content-types.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.files.replace("/media/readme.txt", b"New text.\n", filename="readme.txt")
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
PATCH /Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "file": {
    "data": "TmV3IHRleHQuCg==",
    "encoding": "base64",
    "filename": "readme.txt",
    "content-type": "text/plain"
  }
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X PATCH http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"file":{"data":"TmV3IHRleHQuCg==","encoding":"base64","filename":"readme.txt","content-type":"text/plain"}}'
```
````
`````

The site answers `204`, and the method returns `None`.

### `client.files.download`

Contents of a file field (`@@download`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.files.FilesManager.download`.

Calls `GET /media/readme.txt/@@download/file`.

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.files.download("/media/readme.txt")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client download /media/readme.txt -o readme.txt
```

```json
{
  "path": "readme.txt",
  "size": 10,
  "content-type": "text/plain"
}
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt/@@download/file HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt/@@download/file -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

The method returns the 10 bytes of the file.

### `client.files.tus_upload`

Create an item from a large file, sent in chunks (`@tus-upload`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.files.FilesManager.tus_upload`.

Calls `POST /media/@tus-upload`, `PATCH /media/@tus-upload/3df4921144aa4ae6822ade69c2eabfa9` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/tusupload.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.files.tus_upload("/media", b"A large file.\n", filename="large.txt")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client upload /media notes.txt --tus
```

```json
[
  {
    "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/media/notes.txt"
  }
]
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/media/@tus-upload HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0
Upload-Length: 14
Upload-Metadata: filename bGFyZ2UudHh0,content-type dGV4dC9wbGFpbg==,@type RmlsZQ==,fieldname ZmlsZQ==
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```http
PATCH /Plone/++api++/media/@tus-upload/3df4921144aa4ae6822ade69c2eabfa9 HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0
Upload-Offset: 0
Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

A large file.

```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/media/@tus-upload -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'tus-resumable: 1.0.0' -H 'upload-length: 14' -H 'upload-metadata: filename bGFyZ2UudHh0,content-type dGV4dC9wbGFpbg==,@type RmlsZQ==,fieldname ZmlsZQ==' -u admin:admin
curl -i -X PATCH http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/media/@tus-upload/3df4921144aa4ae6822ade69c2eabfa9 -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'tus-resumable: 1.0.0' -H 'upload-offset: 0' -H 'content-type: application/offset+octet-stream' -u admin:admin --data-raw 'A large file.
'
```
````
`````

```json
"http://localhost:8080/Plone/media/large.txt"
```

### `client.files.tus_replace`

Replace the file of an item with a large file (`@tus-replace`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.files.FilesManager.tus_replace`.

Calls `POST /media/readme.txt/@tus-replace`, `PATCH /media/readme.txt/@tus-upload/3e4be45f149b40fa9266aee8045eaddb` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/tusupload.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.files.tus_replace(
    "/media/readme.txt",
    b"Sample file.\n",
    filename="readme.txt",
    field="file",
)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

POST /Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt/@tus-replace HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0
Upload-Length: 13
Upload-Metadata: filename cmVhZG1lLnR4dA==,content-type dGV4dC9wbGFpbg==,fieldname ZmlsZQ==
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```http
PATCH /Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt/@tus-upload/3e4be45f149b40fa9266aee8045eaddb HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0
Upload-Offset: 0
Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

Sample file.

```

```shell

curl -i -X PATCH http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/media/readme.txt/@tus-upload/3e4be45f149b40fa9266aee8045eaddb -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'tus-resumable: 1.0.0' -H 'upload-offset: 0' -H 'content-type: application/offset+octet-stream' -u admin:admin --data-raw 'Sample file.
'
```
`````
